reponse:
Martin flagged two things on the Nov 12 sync. The webhook problem is fixed on sandbox, but the payout schedules problem is stuck. [1]

**1. Webhook signatures failing on sandbox.** Ellen Vance said every payout.paid and seller.verified event failed verification, with only about 1 in 20 passing. Jake Whitfield took it on the call. [1]
- The cause was that we signed a re-serialized body instead of the bytes we actually sent. [19][4]
- Jake's fix (core#1187) is merged and deployed to sandbox. [19]
- On Nov 17 Ellen turned verification back on. More than 300 events have verified since. [4]
- It goes to production with release 2026.47 on Tue Nov 24. [19][20]

**2. Per-seller payout schedules.** About 200 top sellers are on net-7 and everyone else is on net-30, but Quillon only supports one schedule per platform. Martin said that without per-seller schedules they would be downgrading their best sellers on day one. [1]
- Owen Park didn't commit on the call and told Martin he'd have a clear answer by Friday Nov 20. [1][4]
- Tomer Golan estimated 3–4 weeks of work, including a dry run with Corvane. [3]
- Avi Kessler then moved QPAY-2362 to Backlog with a Q1 2027 target. He wrote that the earliest is late January and asked Owen to set expectations with Martin. [3]
- I found nothing showing that Owen has told Martin yet. Martin said he needs an answer soon, because he has to tell those sellers what happens in December. [1]

The Dec 7 go-live is not affected by the webhook fix. The payout schedules answer is a risk, because Martin said the date can't move. [1]
